title: Control When People Can Post to the General Ledger

features.name: Allow posting from and allow posting to fields
features.description: Fields in general ledger setup that control the date range during which posting to the general ledger is permitted company-wide. Can be set to specific months like November through December.

features.name: User-level posting period override
features.description: The ability to override company-wide posting date restrictions at the user setup page, allowing specific users like accountants to post in periods when others cannot.
